_draft: A2.4 seed for GPS. celestrak.org was UNREACHABLE (connection timed out) from the build env — same as A2.1's ECONNREFUSED — so the CelesTrak GPS-A SupGP pair is NOT captured. See README.md. IMPORTANT: unlike Starlink/ISS, GPS's HARD-RMS parity gate is BLOCKED at the source level (a GPS almanac is mean elements, not a state-vector ephemeris, and we must not fabricate one by propagation) — this manifest documents that, it is not a ready-to-run beatsCelestrak case.
name: GPS almanac (NAVCEN SEM/YUMA) — CelesTrak parity
gateBlockedReason: A GPS almanac is a set of GPS-LNAV mean Keplerian ELEMENTS (not a state-vector ephemeris). The A2.4 hard-RMS gate fits SGP4 to a source state-vector ephemeris and requires our fitted RMS <= CelesTrak SupGP RMS; there is no source ephemeris to fit, and A2.2c-2 forbids fabricating one by propagating the almanac. An element-space comparison vs CelesTrak's GPS-A OMM is also NOT independent parity: it needs (a) a frame reconciliation (GPS-BROADCAST ECEF-week ascending node + GPS-Kepler mean motion vs SGP4 inertial mean elements) and (b) a PRN->NORAD cross-reference the almanac does not carry. UNBLOCK via a GPS state-vector ephemeris source (IGS/precise products) or an owner decision; any interim element check must be labeled non-independent.

tolerances.note: Hard-RMS gate not applicable from the almanac alone (see gateBlockedReason).

elementSpaceNonIndependent.note: If run, MUST be labeled non-independent (requires frame + theory reconciliation).
